prompt: A product design presentation board on a plain very light celeste-white background: exactly three tall portrait smartphone screens standing side by side at equal size, flat screens with thin rounded outlines and no hands, each with a small tracked caption above it: 01 CAPTURE, 02 CROSS-CHECK WITH NASA DATA, 03 PRE-DIAGNOSIS. The app is Field Shift, a crop-rotation and pest pre-diagnosis app for small farmers, English UI text. Type: Source Serif 4 regular for large figures and titles; Source Sans 3 uppercase with wide tracking for small labels. Light daylight theme: white and pale celeste, generous whitespace, 1px hairline rules, sunrise amber used only for warnings and key figures. Each screen calm and uncluttered. No NASA logo, no flags, no mission patches, no people. World: a daylight agroclimatic weather chart, hairline celeste isobars on white chart paper. Screen 01 CAPTURE: a consultant chat. Top: a small map chip showing a drawn field polygon labeled 2.1 ha · Huaral, Peru and a two-way switch My GPS | Example site. A consultant message: What are you growing now, and what grew here before? The farmer replies: Peas now. Lettuce before. A row of four photo thumbnails of green pea plants, one marked blurry. The consultant replies: Thanks. Photo 3 is blurry. Take the underside of a leaf, closer. Bottom: a camera button and a text field Up to 10 photos. Screen 02 CROSS-CHECK WITH NASA DATA: the field drawn as a weather station-model glyph on a pale chart with isobars; around the glyph six sectors fill one by one, each with its label and source: Temperature +1.2 °C · NASA POWER; Soil moisture drier than normal · SMAP; Rain 3 mm this month · GPM IMERG; Crop vigor 0.48 · Sentinel-2 NDVI; Slope 2% · SRTM; 2040 projection +1.8 °C · NEX-GDDP. Below the glyph, a small evidence table with two columns PHOTO and SATELLITE: Yellowing lower leaves matches Soil drier than normal (agrees, check mark); Aphids on leaf underside matches +2 pest generations (agrees). Screen 03 PRE-DIAGNOSIS: a tag PRE-DIAGNOSIS · NOT A DIAGNOSIS, a serif headline Likely water stress with early aphid pressure, a confidence meter reading Medium confidence, and a line Confirm with your agronomist. Then three compact rotation rows: Current pea then lettuce; A add a legume; B green manure, one marked recommended. A short pest-care row: Release lacewings (Chrysoperla) · Trichoderma in compost. Bottom: a full-width button Export technical sheet (PDF) with a small note Every number cites its source.
